name: Synn
message: 「Okay, next it's Ria-senpai's turn. Say aah.」
Ria-senpai is trembling slightly with her eyes closed and her mouth still wide open.
I had stopped the food on my fork right in front of her open mouth.
She bites down, chews with puffed cheeks, and gulps it down.

name: Synn
message: 「You looked so cute waiting like that, I couldn't help it.」

name: Ria
message: 「You think you can get away with anything just by calling me cute! Geez, I don't care anymore!」
Ria-senpai puffs out her cheeks and turns away.

name: Ria
message: 「--Pah... th-that's not... gonna make me forgive you, hmph\s03」
Even as she says that, her cheeks have already completely melted into a soft smile.
Ah, I'm kissing a girl this cute...
Ria-senpai forcefully shoves a piece of karaage against my mouth.

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph! I can see right through everything you're thinking, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Things have been quiet lately, haven't they」

name: Ria
message: 「Really? I think everyone's getting restless with the Holy Night Festival coming up」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm not restless! My heart's just pounding with excitement!」

name: Synn
message: 「Those are the same thing--wait, that's not what I meant. I mean the demons have been quiet. Like Bylous」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... it's almost like they're preparing for when the time comes, isn't it」

name: Ria
message: 「Melilot-san... won't talk about Azel-san at all. I wonder if things aren't going well」

name: Synn
message: 「It doesn't look like she's come back to the dorm either... Where could she have gone? I'm worried...」
I wonder if she's sleeping in a warm futon properly. I wonder if she's going hungry.

name: Synn
message: 「For some reason, I feel a sense of closeness with Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really know how to put it, but... I haven't been able to just leave her alone for a while now」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What are you saying?! It's not like I feel that way about Azel--」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, you've thought she was cute before, haven't you」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe... You're so honest. If you say things like that, I'll get even more jealous♪」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, though... I'm gonna make you so crazy about me that you won't even be able to look at other girls!」
If I leave things up to Senpai, there's no telling what she'll do to me.
Ahh... From now on, I'm going to be spending my days with a playful senpai like her...
Just looking at Ria-senpai made me so embarrassed that I bolted without thinking.
